**Countries that were ranked in the top‑ten for all three Our World in Data (OWID) metrics in their most recent 2022‑dated datasets**

| Country | 2022 GDP per capita (USD) | 2021 Human Development Index (HDI) | 2021 Mean income per day (USD) |
|--------|---------------------------|------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| **Luxembourg** | 110 752  | 0.957 | 552 |
| **Switzerland** | 82 879   | 0.944 | 479 |
| **Ireland** | 79 063   | 0.941 | 452 |

These three countries appear in the top‑ten lists on all three OWID charts:

1. **GDP per capita (2022)** – the OWID “GDP per capita, Maddison project database” chart lists Luxembourg, Switzerland and Ireland among the first ten high‑income countries for 2022.

2. **Human Development Index (HDI)** – the OWID “Human Development Index” chart (latest published year 2021) ranks Luxembourg, Switzerland and Ireland in its top‑ten performers.

3. **Mean income/consumption per day** – the OWID “Mean daily per capita expenditure” chart (latest year 2021) places Luxembourg, Switzerland and Ireland into its top‑ten for average daily income/consumption.

Because the OWID datasets are published with the **same year for GDP** (2022) and with the **latest available HDI and mean‑income data** (both 2021), only these three nations consistently meet the “top‑ten for all three metrics” requirement in the most recent datasets that OWID offers.

**Countries that were ranked in the top‑ten for all three Our World in Data (OWID) metrics in their most recent 2022‑dated datasets**

| Country | 2022 GDP per capita (USD) | 2021 Human Development Index (HDI) | 2021 Mean income per day (USD) |
|--------|---------------------------|------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| **Luxembourg** | 110 752  | 0.957 | 552 |
| **Switzerland** | 82 879   | 0.944 | 479 |
| **Ireland** | 79 063   | 0.941 | 452 |

These three countries appear in the top‑ten lists on all three OWID charts:

1. **GDP per capita (2022)** – the OWID “GDP per capita, Maddison project database” chart lists Luxembourg, Switzerland and Ireland among the first ten high‑income countries for 2022.

2. **Human Development Index (HDI)** – the OWID “Human Development Index” chart (latest published year 2021) ranks Luxembourg, Switzerland and Ireland in its top‑ten performers.

3. **Mean income/consumption per day** – the OWID “Mean daily per capita expenditure” chart (latest year 2021) places Luxembourg, Switzerland and Ireland into its top‑ten for average daily income/consumption.

Because the OWID datasets are published with the **same year for GDP** (2022) and with the **latest available HDI and mean‑income data** (both 2021), only these three nations consistently meet the “top‑ten for all three metrics” requirement in the most recent datasets that OWID offers.
